description: This is a test class for the ThemeService in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to theme variables, images, and display options within the ThemeService class.

classes.name: ThemeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ThemeService plugin’s functionalities related to theme display and images within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up test data fixtures.

methods.name: testShowSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Tests whether social media images are correctly shown depending on the theme (custom or default).

methods.name: testGetCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of current theme variables for both custom and default themes, including caching behavior.

methods.name: testGetImageETagWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks that the getImageETag method correctly returns null when no image is available.

methods.name: testGetImage
methods.description: Verifies that the getImage method returns the expected image object for a given image key.

methods.name: testGetImageWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks that getImage returns null when no image exists for the provided key.
